So before I can approve the protocol, we need two changes to the screening draft: (a) blur the interview subject's face and omit their name in the interview segment, and (b) replace the open-floor audience question period with a card-based, moderator-read Q&A format.

Elias, can you confirm that once the interview segment is modified to blur the face and omit the name, you'll be able to sign off on clearance? And Nina, can you confirm that once the Q&A format is updated to cards-and-moderator, you'll be able to sign off on the event side? Once I hear back from both of you, I'll make the final approval decision.
